flow: lineage market on Sepolia — chain only; no app screen changed, so there are no cdp-drive actions
build: bun run contracts:build (solc 0.8.37, optimizer 200, evmVersion cancun) → contracts/LineageMarket.json

env.UNWRITTEN_PRIVATE_KEY: unset — the dry run acts as a throwaway account funded by a state override

chain.method: eth_simulateV1: every call replayed as simulated blocks on the Sepolia block the run started from; nothing sent
